description:
TagSpaces helps you organize, tag, and browse your files, photos, and documents across multiple platforms — completely offline and without cloud dependencies.
It’s perfect for:
• Browsing, tagging, viewing, and editing local files directly in the app — no external software required
• Taking notes or saving web snippets (like Evernote®, but 100% offline)
• Building a personal knowledge base or personal wiki using local files
Key Features
• File & Folder Management — Browse, preview, and organize files with a clean, intuitive interface.
• Smart Tagging — Add tags to files and folders. Tags can be embedded in filenames or stored in lightweight sidecar files.
• Powerful Search — Fast fuzzy search and tag-based filtering across all connected locations.
• Offline & Private — Runs entirely on your device. No login, no tracking, no mandatory cloud services.
• Built-in Viewers & Media Player — Preview images, PDFs, text, Markdown and play audio/video directly in the app.
• Note Taking — Create and edit notes in plain text, Markdown, or HTML formats.
• To-Do Management — Use the built-in editor to create simple to-do lists in HTML or Markdown files.
• Cross-Platform — Available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android with a consistent experience.
• Web Clipper Extension — Capture web pages, screenshots, and bookmarks as files with the TagSpaces Web Clipper for Firefox and Chrome.
Your Data. Your Rules.
TagSpaces is designed with privacy in mind — it doesn’t require an account, it doesn’t track your activity, and your files remain under your control.
Try TagSpaces today — organize smarter, stay private, and keep your files flexible and future-proof.
